name: norsk-lesson-factory
description: Open Norwegian Bokmål lesson data plus the agentic QA pipeline used to build and maintain it.

scripts.eval:prompt: for config in evals/promptfoo/*.yaml; do npm run eval:promptfoo -- -c "$config" || exit $?; done
scripts.eval:promptfoo: PROMPTFOO_PYTHON=$(uv run which python) npx --yes promptfoo@0.125.0 eval --no-cache --no-write --max-concurrency 1
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && npm --prefix workbench run format
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check . && npm --prefix workbench run format:check
scripts.workbench:test: npm --prefix workbench test && npm --prefix workbench run typecheck
scripts.workbench:types:generate: uv run python scripts/export_workbench_schema.py && npm --prefix workbench run types:generate
scripts.workbench:types:check: uv run python scripts/export_workbench_schema.py --check && npm --prefix workbench run types:check
